description_en: This operation queries the parameter templates in a specified region
description_zh: 查看目标地域的参数模板列表
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-parameter-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-type MySQL --db-version 8.0 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameterGroups

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region.

> Call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the information about all available regions of your account, including the region IDs.
parameters.description_zh:

> 您可以通过[DescribeRegions](~~98041~~)接口查看当前账号下的所有可用地域信息，包括地域ID。
